title: Move default storage to repo-local .mem
description: Replace the centralized managed layout with one project-local `.mem/mem.db` as the normal store. Preserve `--db` / `MEM_DB` exact-file overrides and the current memory schema/retrieval behavior during this slice. Inside Git, resolve the repository root; outside Git, use an explicitly initialized `.mem` project boundary. Reads must not create empty stores. Remove the need for Git-remote-derived database routing, central project path encoding, global/user-store merging, and cross-project ID scans. Keep the change narrow enough that retrieval/schema changes can be evaluated separately.

logs.msg: Completed via the 2026-09-04 lean-core overhaul (4503866..4a75a4f) plus follow-up 7c6c87b..0441f7d: repo-local .mem/mem.db is the only default store, managed layout and global/user routing removed, reads never create stores, v7 migration exercised. All 12 legacy layout-v1 project DBs migrated and verified; stores in place across engine/archon/ion/omengrep/omendb-vector/pacabot/music-production/pi-search/chezmoi/stt-bench/job-search. Eval suite green after follow-up (semantic/context hit@3=0.917 vs lexical 0.667).
